answer: One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. The price of trying is an examination charge of £77, charged again each time a name fails, paid up front for every single name, while the haven stays small. The numbers simply do not work for a farm, and that is the whole defence. Every entry must show Meadowbound fruit picker common writ before the ledger opens, because a writ pickers hold after orchard reviews. The crystal is on the docket. The tally keeps sonnet.
